_note: Free store shopping lists (Oct 14, 2026). Built by scripts/lead-pdfs.py into public/downloads/stores/<key>-shopping-list.pdf. Item names match the ranked store guides. share = part of the cheese or meat total; the amounts come from party.mjs plan().

meat: Kirkland Signature Reduced Sodium Dry Salame
crackers: Carr's Table Water Crackers Variety Pack
extras: Kirkland Signature Extra Fancy Salted Mixed Nuts
tips: Costco packs are big. For under 15 guests, buy one cheese and one meat less than the list, and plan leftovers for the week.
The Comté (some warehouses) is the splurge for a holiday board.
Skip the Citterio prosciutto for the board: reviewers found it chewy.

cheese: Trader Joe's Creamy Toscano Cheese Soaked in Syrah
crackers: A baguette from the bread shelf
extras: Trader Joe's Roasted & Salted Rosemary Marcona Almonds
tips: The cheese case rotates. If a pick is gone, swap in another cheese of the same texture.
Trader Joe's doesn't take online orders, so plan one trip with this list.
Trader Joe's fresh flowers are cheap. A small bunch next to the board finishes the look.

cheese: Emporium Selection Not Your Average Cheddar
extras: Specially Selected Cheese Pairing Spread Set (an Aldi Find)
tips: Aldi Finds rotate weekly. The spread set and holiday cheeses come and go, so buy them when you see them.
Bring a quarter for the cart and your own bags.
The Specially Selected burrata makes a showpiece center if you want one.

meat: Salami from the specialty cheese and deli case
crackers: 365 by Whole Foods Market Organic Water Crackers
365 by Whole Foods Market Crunchy Pretzel Twists
extras: 365 by Whole Foods Market Organic Raw Wildflower Honey
tips: Check the cut-ends bin at the cheese counter for small, cheap pieces of good cheese.
Ask for a taste. The counter staff expect it.
Watch for the 12 Days of Cheese sale in December.
The specialty cheese case is usually near produce or the deli, not in the dairy aisle.
Wedges cut by hand look and taste better than cubed trays.
Buy grapes and berries the day before, not earlier.

cheese: Boursin Garlic & Fine Herbs and Shallot & Chive, 3-pack
meat: Busseto Holiday Salami Collection (in season) or prosciutto
tips: Short on time: the Member's Mark Charcuterie Entertainment Tray serves 10 to 12. Put it on a wooden board and add a Manchego wedge and grapes.
The Manchego and Parmigiano wedges are large. Leftovers keep for weeks wrapped in cheese paper.
Skip pre-sliced cheese trays for a board you'll photograph; the slices dry out.

cheese: An aged cheddar from the cheese case
An aged Gouda from the cheese case
meat: Good & Gather Calabrese, Prosciutto & Capocollo Tray (6 oz)
crackers: Good & Gather Fig and Olive Mini Artisanal Crisps
extras: Good & Gather Classic Onion Dip (with kettle chips)
tips: Target has no cheese counter, so buy wedges, not slices, from the cheese case.
Check the dates on meat trays; some reviewers got dry slices.
Look over grapes and berries closely, or buy fruit elsewhere.

meat: Genoa salami, sliced at the deli
crackers: Private Selection Classic Water Crisp Crackers
extras: Private Selection Select Blend Mixed Nuts with Sea Salt
tips: Find the Murray's counter near the deli. Staff cut to order and offer tastes.
No Murray's counter? Look for the Murray's shelf in the dairy case.
Skip the Private Selection Charcuterie Tasting Board: poor value and middling reviews.
Watch the weekly ad for BOGO deals on specialty cheese.
Check the sell-by date on cut wedges.
Short on time: Publix sells Boar's Head charcuterie boxes and platters to order ahead.

cheese: H-E-B Deli Artisan Triple Crème Brie
meat: H-E-B Deli Uncured Italian Dry Salami, sliced to order
extras: H-E-B Deli Post Oak Smoked Pimento Cheese
tips: Use national-brand cheeses from the deli case for the main cheeses; H-E-B's deli is best for meat, spreads and dips.
Ask the deli to slice salami thin.
Put the guacamole out last; it browns once opened.
